description: Audit a Helm values file against a contract the caller states, and optionally against a second environment. Reports a required path absent or null, so the chart renders with its own default instead; a value whose type is not what was declared, naming the YAML cause where there is one; a value outside a permitted set; a path the contract does not mention, which Helm ignores silently so a typo never surfaces; and a path stated in one environment and not the other. Pay 160000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

compare_with.description: A second values file, such as another environment, to compare which paths and types each states. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
compare_with.example:
replicaCount: 2
image:
  repository: ghcr.io/example/web
  tag: 1.4.0
environment: staging
ingress:
  enabled: false
  host: staging.example.test

contract.description: What the values must satisfy, written in the dotted notation a template uses. An unknown property here is refused rather than ignored.

forbid_unknown.description: Report a path the contract does not mention. Defaults to false, since a partial contract is normal.

types.description: Per path, one of string, number, boolean, array, object or null.

values.description: The values file to audit. YAML, read as a documented subset: block mappings and sequences, flow collections of scalars, block scalars, and multiple documents separated by ---. Anchors, aliases, merge keys and explicit tags are refused with the line rather than half parsed. Nothing is fetched: no cluster, registry or repository is contacted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.
values.example:
replicaCount: "2"
image:
  repository: ghcr.io/example/web
environment: prod
ingress:
  enabled: yes

name: helm_values_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every declared rule was evaluated and none failed.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Helm Values Contract Audit
